customers.evidence: We believe our first responsibility is to the patients, doctors and nurses, to mothers and fathers and all others who use our products and services.

employees.evidence: We are responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world.

dei.evidence: We must provide an inclusive work environment where each person must be considered as an individual.

environment.evidence: We must maintain in good order the property we are privileged to use, protecting the environment and natural resources.

community.evidence: We are responsible to the communities in which we live and work and to the world community as well.

shareholders.evidence: Our final responsibility is to our stockholders.

integrity.evidence: We must provide highly capable leaders and their actions must be just and ethical.

safety.evidence: Compensation must be fair and adequate and working conditions clean, orderly and safe.

innovation.evidence: We must experiment with new ideas. Research must be carried on, innovative programs developed, investments made for the future and mistakes paid for.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, absolute voice built on repeated 'must' and 'we are responsible', with few hedges. The page ranks stakeholders explicitly: patients first, employees second, communities third, stockholders last ('final responsibility'). Distinctive wording: 'first responsibility' and 'final responsibility' frame the ordering. Commitments are broad, with little measurable detail.
